request: Rename Todo.done to Todo.completed everywhere, and make list hide completed todos by default (includeDone: true shows them). --behaviour

requests.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
requests.reason: This test expected list(todos) with no options to include completed todos ("[x] milk\n[ ] eggs"). The instruction changes the default so completed todos are hidden, which means that assertion can't pass anymore. I updated it: list(todos) now expects "[ ] eggs", and list(todos, { includeDone: true }) expects the full list.
